question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Garnish
solution:
The correct answer is: **Decorate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Garnish"** means to add decorative or savory touches to food or drink. (सजाना)
 
 
• **Example: **The chef decided to garnish the dish with fresh herbs and a slice of lemon.
 
 
 
• **"Decorate" **means to make something look more attractive by adding items or images to it. (सजाना)
 
 
• **Example: **They decided to decorate the room with balloons and streamers for the birthday party.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Garnish' **is **'Decorate'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Decorate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dwindle **(घट जाना): To become steadily less or diminish.
 
 
• **Example:** The supplies of food began to dwindle as the harsh winter continued.
 
 
 
• **Tarnish **(कलंकित करना): To lose luster or become discolored, usually due to exposure to air or moisture.
 
 
• **Example: **The silverware began to tarnish after being left out in the open.
 
 
 
• **Blemish** (दाग): An imperfection or flaw that spoils the appearance.
 
 
• **Example:** The painting had a small blemish on the corner that was barely noticeable.
